summary.plain: A tank holding about a third of a tonne of liquid xenon, with light sensors above and below it, in the Davis Cavern a mile underground in South Dakota. It looked for the flash of light from dark matter hitting a xenon nucleus.
summary.technical: Dual-phase xenon TPC, 370 kg total xenon, 250 kg active, 118 kg fiducial in WS2013, in the Davis Cavern at SURF; its cavern was reused for LZ.
